sloka: न्यवसन् सुसुखम् तत्र काम आश्रम पदे तथा ।कथाभिरभिरामभिरभिरमौ नृपात्मजौ ।यद्वा -कथाभिः अभि रामभिः अभि रमौ नृप आत्मजौरमयामास धर्मात्मा कौशिको मुनिपुङ्गवः ॥१-२३-२२॥
transliteration: nyavasan susukham tatra kāma āśrama pade tathā ।kathābhirabhirāmabhirabhiramau nṛpātmajau ।yadvā -kathābhiḥ abhi rāmabhiḥ abhi ramau nṛpa ātmajauramayāmāsa dharmātmā kauśiko munipuṅgavaḥ ॥1-23-22॥

translations.english: Foremost among the ascetics the son of Kusika (Viswamitra) delighted the charming princes with enchanting tales. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये बालकाण्डे त्रयोविंशस्सर्ग:।। Thus ends the twentythird sarga of Balakanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
